nota: Testemunho de época (Dana), não medição. A edição da tela é a de 1895 (grifo lido na imagem pelo verificador); o texto aqui conferido é o do Gutenberg (ed. de 1869), igual no trecho.
narracao: In 1835, Richard Henry Dana's ship anchored about three miles out, and the crew called it the worst place they had seen for loading hides.

na_tela.texto: We all agreed that it was the worst place we had seen yet, especially for getting off hides
Source: Richard Henry Dana Jr., Two Years Before the Mast (1895 edition)
